summary: BP-AUTOALIGN implements business-reliable semantic lifecycle completion: governed writes are business-complete only after embedding generation, durable projection, touched-record queryability, global coherence, and Aligned readiness across Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View; ordinary semantic queries auto-align and retry once when readiness is unaligned; unrecoverable alignment fails closed with stable diagnostics and no full-snapshot fallback.
